summary: The Big Cop moves to cuff Trinity while the other cops hold her, confident they have her. Trinity moves with inhuman speed, snapping up her palm to explode the Big Cop's nose and kicking him back into another cop. As the remaining cops fire bullets and sweep flashlights in panic, Trinity snatches a gun from a cop's hand, twists it, and fires. After a final exchange of gunfire, Trinity is the only one standing, and she says 'Shit.'

what_changes.before: Standing, holding a bead, reaching with the cuffs
what_changes.after: Flying back, slams into the cop farthest from her

what_changes.before: Holding a bead, confident they've got her
what_changes.after: Trying to stop a leather-clad ghost, panicking, eventually dead

event_hint.one_line: Trinity defeats the police officers attempting to arrest her.
